tasks.subject: Task 1: uptime_seconds in /api/metrics
tasks.description:

**Files:**

tasks.subject: Task 2: header uptime + width caps in panel
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Header shows up <uptime> + updated Ns ago; window rows and endpoint table stop stretching across wide columns.

**Files:**
- Modify: frontend/src/types/metrics.ts
- Modify: frontend/src/components/MetricsPanel.vue

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] MetricsSnapshot has uptime_seconds: number
- [ ] Header renders up 3d 4h + updated 12s ago once data exists (frozen while collapsed)
- [ ] fmtUptime: 274680s->3d 4h; 18720s->5h 12m; 720s->12m; 45s->45s; negative->0s
- [ ] max-w-[200px] on window rows; max-w-[560px] on endpoint table
- [ ] npm run build exits 0

**Verify:** cd frontend && npm run build -> exit 0

**Steps:** full code in plan Task 2. Commit: git commit -s, never Co-Authored-By.
